about.text: a traditionally southern Italian dairy product made by the pasta filata method. Mozzarella received a Traditional Speciality Guaranteed certification from the European Union in 1998. This protection scheme requires that mozzarella sold in the European Union is produced according to a traditional recipe.

facts.v: Cow's-milk mozzarella is called fior di latte; buffalo mozzarella is made nationwide
The Argentine Food Code defines Queso Mozzarella as a stretched-curd cheese, made by stretching an acidified curd
